name: Thumbnail Grabber for YouTube
description: Download the thumbnail of the YouTube video you are watching, in every size up to 1280x720 plus the Shorts image. No tracking.
author: ThumbnailsGrabber

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; img-src 'self' https://i.ytimg.com https://img.youtube.com blob:; connect-src https://i.ytimg.com https://img.youtube.com
